title: Count Latencies in Fixed-Width Buckets
prompt:
Implement `calc_buckets(latencies, bucket_count, bucket_width) -> list[int]`.

Given nonnegative integer latencies, count how many values fall in each fixed-width bucket. Bucket `i` normally covers `[i * bucket_width, (i + 1) * bucket_width)`. The first bucket starts at zero. The last bucket is an overflow bucket: it includes every value at or above its lower bound, even when that value would fall beyond the nominal upper bound.

`bucket_count` and `bucket_width` must be positive integers. Latencies must be nonnegative integers. Assert these input conditions. Return one count per bucket; an empty input returns all zeroes.

example.reasoning: Buckets cover 0–9 and 10–19; the last bucket starts at 20 and absorbs 20 and 30.
